method: Read1000 additional contiguous lines: GDI helpers, PNG icons and clipboard image conversion/persistence. Static ownership/bounds analysis only.
findings: copy_image_to_clipboard frees allocation on GlobalLock/OpenClipboard/SetClipboardData failures, closes clipboard and transfers ownership on success. This is explicit error handling; earlier sequential-text paste ownership gap must not be generalized to this function.

image_to_dib_bytes uses checked pixel-count multiplication and writes bottom-up BGRA with alpha forced255. Transparency is intentionally discarded in this clipboard conversion; no claim of lossless RGBA roundtrip.

clipboard_bitmap_byte_len rejects nonpositive dimensions, sides above6000 and decoded bytes above50MiB for CF_BITMAP fallback. Direct CF_DIB/V5 path copies GlobalSize data and does not use this helper, so limit is not global across clipboard formats.
latest_clipboard_image_path orders pinned DESC before timestamp DESC. Latest-screenshot action can select older pinned image over newer unpinned. No filesystem existence check in selector.

clipboard_image_path uses millisecond-only image filename; save uses overwrite-capable fs::write, so same-millisecond captures can overwrite prior image and upsert same content path. Actual event frequency unmeasured; no user screen captured.

Image file is written before DB open/upsert; database failure returns None with saved orphan file left behind. History retention deletes database records only in this branch; saved image cleanup elsewhere pending.
Automatic image OCR publishes WM_REFRESH_SEARCH without boxed payload, so earlier raw-pointer publication leak does not apply to this notification. COM init balanced on successful init.

Capture DIB/bitmap helpers call OpenClipboard directly without shared clipboard_lock, despite nearby global serialization comment. They can contend with copy/paste workers and returnNone; no live clipboard fixture.

paste_into_window sleeps80ms synchronously, attempts foreground then injects paste without checking focus success or SendInput count. Callers include UI thread; no keyboard actions executed or measured.

Highlighted-text painter reserves up to2000pixels rather than badge boundary, so earlier long-description overflow remains source-supported. PNG icon helper premultiplies before resize and initializes mask; no visual fidelity/decoder runtime acceptance.
limits: No new tests, clipboard/Windows actions, screenshots or production edits.
